adjacent.text: Merrill: The 4Q23 supplement (period ended December 31, 2023) reports 18,916 total wealth advisors at period end, a figure that includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking, not Merrill advisors alone.
adjacent.differs_because: Total wealth advisors includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking, so it is wider than Merrill's own advisor headcount.

adjacent.text: Merrill: A Bank of America investor-day deck (published November 5, 2025) states Merrill and the Private Bank together have more than 15,000 wealth advisors.
adjacent.differs_because: The more-than-15,000 figure combines Merrill and the Private Bank, so it is not Merrill's advisors alone.

adjacent.text: Merrill: Bank of America's CFO stated (2Q26, period ended June 30, 2026) that adviser attrition is now at near historic lows.
adjacent.differs_because: It states attrition only qualitatively (near historic lows) rather than as a numeric headcount or rate.
